name: Pusher API
project_description:
Bi-directional hosted APIs that are flexible, scalable and easy to use. We create and maintain complex messaging infrastructure so you can build the realtime features your users need, fast.

 This module integrates Drupal and Pusher providing a simple yet flexible developer focused API to build out realtime features in Drupal.

 Roadmap 
 3.x 
 3.0.0-beta1 is finally here! This release provides a brand new public API and a default set of services to use as part of your feature development. Better documentation to follow (PRs welcome).

 3.x is a complete redesign, from the ground up. The aim of this new major version is to provide a framework that integrates Pusher seamlessly with Drupals API to allow for rich feature sets and functionality to be built. This module will be extended by supplementary modules to further its functionality in a more modular approach.

 3.x is still under active development updates planned for August 2025.

 2.x has been fully deprecated, none of its public APIs will be available in 3.x and no backwards compatibility will be provided. 3.x will contain braking changes.
